title: Companion website for Redin Hurtado et al. 2026
text:
This website is a companion to the OSF project Beyond cumulative scores: A dimensional analysis of early-life adversity and behavioural outcomes in Macaca.
See this Github repository to access the code for the project.

text:
Regression models

check_diag_measures <- function(fit, m = 10) {

    # Investigate convergence of the original models
    draws <- as_draws_array(fit)
    draws_per_dat <- lapply(1:10, \(i) subset_draws(draws, chain = i))
    list_diag_measures <- lapply(draws_per_dat, summarise_draws,
                                 default_convergence_measures())
    
    purrr::walk(1:m, \(x) {
        print(paste0("Imputed dataframe ", x, " :"))
        print(list_diag_measures[[x]], n = Inf)
    })

}
